title: 1950 AHSME Problem 17
statement:
The formula which expresses the relationship between \(x\) and \(y\) as shown in the accompanying table is:

\[ \begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|} \hline x&0&1&2&3&4\\ \hline y&100&90&70&40&0\\ \hline \end{array} \]

solutions.text:
At \(x=1,\) choices A and C both give \(90,\) while B gives \(95\) and D gives \(18.\) Testing the two survivors at \(x=2,\) choice A gives \(80,\) whereas choice C gives \[ 100-5(2)-5(2^2)=70, \] matching the table.

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: Substitute a small nonzero table value such as \(x=1\) into each proposed formula
Then verify the surviving formula with \(x=2\) or \(x=3\)
